headline: Nigerian Stock Exchange Market Capitalization Falls N2.27 Trillion Led by Dangote Cement
summary: Equity market value on the Nigerian Exchange dropped by N2.27 trillion in a single trading session. Intense selling pressure across heavyweight shares was led by Dangote Cement.
why: Dangote Cement is West Africa's largest cement producer and a major listed firm in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Dangote Cement
impacts.why: Heavy selling in Dangote Cement heavily depressed the broader Nigerian equity benchmark.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sharp selling in Dangote Cement and blue-chip equities wiped out N2.27 trillion in Nigerian stock market value.
